title: Edenpunk SMP: Lifesteal Season Modpack
description: A modpack heavily focused on exploration and gear, it aims to incentivize our use of the lifesteal mod so we could have a season with some more "lore" on our server :p
body:
A exploration and gear heavy modpack that aims to change things up from our first SMP season.

Has a bigger focus on exploration and making player interaction the core of the gameplay thanks to the Lifesteal mod, with revamped structes and player-based loot, game progression should (hopefully) feel less grindy and more adventury. The modpack is built to run on low-end computers, with most optimization mods included.

There is a wide range of gear, tools, dungeons and new mechanics like reworks to transportation, expansion on boats, elytras, and origins that drastically change how you interact with the world and design your base - You can live on the seas and always be on the move or build on a totally separate dimension that better suits your species.

Includes some server-maintenance mods like endernexus to make gameplay more fun and the server more welcoming.
